help.title: About — MOONDROP:Gravity Position for Linux
help.subtitle: Native hardware DSP, AutoEq & UAC2 control for Linux gamers and IEM enthusiasts
help.why_body:
• Linux Gaming & Low Latency: hardware DSP on the DAC (< 5 ms, UAC2 up to 384 kHz via PipeWire) works across every game (Steam/Proton, native) and voice chat with zero CPU overhead and no browser needed.
  • Massive AutoEq Database & Fit Range: thousands of IEM & over-ear measurements (Crinacle, Oratory1990, Rtings, etc.) plus custom REW/CSV curves — with optional range limit (6 / 4 / 2 kHz) to leave upper bands free.
  • Interactive EQ & parity with hub.moondroplab.tech: 8 bands (PK/LP/HP), drag handles 1–8 on the curve (scroll wheel for Q), Auto Headroom, live preview with safe state restore, and Equalizer APO (.txt) / JSON export.
help.tips_body:
• Drag & Drop & tooltips: drop any .json, Equalizer APO (.txt), or .csv/.txt curve onto the window; hover over any control for help.
  • Safe workflow: saving to disk (Save for later / Save profile) is strictly separate from flashing the DAC (Apply to DAC).
  • Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+F (search profiles) · Ctrl+O (import JSON / Equalizer APO) · Ctrl+Q (quit).
help.body_html:
Why a native Linux version?

  • Linux Gaming & Low Latency: Hardware DSP on the DAC (< 5 ms, UAC2 up to 384 kHz via PipeWire) works across every game (Steam/Proton, native) and voice chat with zero CPU overhead and no browser needed.
  • Massive AutoEq Database: Built-in access to thousands of IEM & over-ear measurements plus custom REW/CSV curves — automatically optimized for Position's exact 8 hardware bands.
  • Full parity with hub.moondroplab.tech: 8-band EQ (PK/LP/HP), pre-gain, global gain, mic gain, live preview with safe state restore, backup, and offline tray operation.

Tips & Shortcuts

  • Hover over any button, slider, filter, or plot to see a tooltip explaining what it does.
  • Saving to disk (Save for later / Save profile) is separate from flashing the DAC (Apply to DAC).
  • Shortcuts: Ctrl+F — search profiles · Ctrl+O — import JSON/APO · Ctrl+Q — quit.
tooltip.connection:
USB HID connection status (35d8:0123, report 0x4B) or demo simulator.
If hardware is not detected on the host, check the udev rule for /dev/hidraw*.
tooltip.source_my_profiles: Your local EQ profiles (built-in and saved on disk) ready for preview, editing, and flashing.
tooltip.source_autoeq:
Database of thousands of headphone measurements and AutoEq target curves.
Pick a target and compute an 8-band fit for Position's hardware DSP.
tooltip.profile_search: Filter saved profiles by name (shortcut: Ctrl+F).
tooltip.profiles_list: Select a profile to preview the predicted IEM frequency response and EQ correction curve.
tooltip.autoeq_mode: Filter the catalog by headphone form factor (in-ear / over-ear) or target curves.
tooltip.autoeq_source: Narrow results to a specific measurement database (e.g., Crinacle, Oratory1990).
tooltip.autoeq_search: Search by headphone model or measurement source (shortcut: Ctrl+F).
tooltip.autoeq_catalog_btn: Fetch the latest AutoEq catalog from GitHub, open a local folder, or load a custom CSV/TXT (REW) curve.
tooltip.autoeq_compute: Run the AutoEq optimizer to compute 8 PK bands within MOONDROP:Gravity Position hardware limits.
tooltip.preview_plot: Predicted MOONDROP:Gravity Position response based on the factory technical specification curve (B&K 5128) and selected EQ profile.
tooltip.correction_plot: Combined 8-band EQ correction curve including pre-gain (in dB).
tooltip.add_profile: Create a new profile from scratch or import a JSON / Equalizer APO file (Ctrl+O).
tooltip.more_actions: Duplicate, export, or delete the selected user profile (deleting never alters DAC state).
tooltip.edit_eq: Open the 8-band EQ editor with real-time curve preview and live DAC auditioning.
tooltip.save_later: Save the computed AutoEq profile to My profiles on disk without flashing the DAC.
tooltip.apply_dac: Write the selected profile to the DAC's Custom slot (7) in flash memory with readback verification.
tooltip.device_slot: Slot 0 = factory Default (read-only), Slot 7 = Custom (writable user profile).
tooltip.device_firmware: Firmware version reported by the MOONDROP:Gravity Position DSP controller.
tooltip.device_preamp: Global attenuation before the EQ stage (prevents digital clipping when boosting bands).
tooltip.output_gain: DAC output attenuation (Global gain, −18…0 dB). Applied temporarily without flash write.
tooltip.mic_gain: Inline 3.5 mm microphone gain (read and set via HID report 0x4B).
tooltip.sample_rate: Force PipeWire sample rate (clock.force-rate) or leave on Automatic.
tooltip.apply_rate: Apply the selected sample rate in PipeWire.
tooltip.refresh_rate: Re-read the active ALSA stream format and sample rate (/proc/asound).
tooltip.theme: Choose the InnoVibe-inspired dark or light theme (or follow your desktop setting).
tooltip.language: Switch interface language (PL / EN or follow system locale).
tooltip.export_dac: Back up the current Custom slot profile from the DAC to a JSON file.
tooltip.factory_reset: Restore factory defaults on the DAC (Default slot 0).
tooltip.editor_name: Profile name stored in your local library or exported JSON.
tooltip.editor_preamp: Pre-gain (−128…0 dB). Use a negative value when boosting bands to prevent clipping.
tooltip.editor_load_dac: Load the current 8 bands and pre-gain directly from the connected DAC.
tooltip.editor_compare: Overlay the initial profile as a dashed curve for A/B visual comparison.
tooltip.editor_gain_options: Optionally bundle output gain and microphone gain into this profile.
tooltip.editor_save: Save the profile to My profiles on disk (does not alter DAC state).
tooltip.editor_export: Export the edited profile to JSON or Equalizer APO (.txt).
tooltip.editor_upload: Flash the edited profile directly to the DAC's Custom slot (7).
tooltip.editor_auto_headroom: Automatically set pre-gain so the combined EQ curve peak stays at or below 0 dB.
editor.headroom_clip: ⚠ Clipping risk (+{peak:.2f} dB) — click Auto Headroom
editor.plot_drag_hint: Drag handles 1–8 on the plot to adjust Freq and Gain; scroll wheel adjusts Q.
tooltip.autoeq_fit_range: Limit AutoEq fitting to a cutoff frequency, leaving remaining bands free for manual treble tuning.
drop.unsupported: Unsupported file “{name}”. Drop JSON, Equalizer APO (.txt), or CSV/TXT curve.
